prerequisites: Knowledge of the contents of basic first and second-year courses
Knowledge of the contents of more technological courses
Having previously taken the "Industrial Construction" course

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and abilities to apply the scientific and technological foundations of industrial constructions.

syllabus_topics: Ordinances and interior works on plots
Basic installations in the industrial building
Health and safety in construction works
Regulation of production and management of construction and demolition waste. Management studies.
teaching_methods: Autonomous learning (reading and comprehension of basic bibliography texts)
assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained by summing 20% of the average score from Continuous Assessment Tests (PEC) and 80% of the score from the in-person exam. For both the exam and PECs, the assessment criteria emphasize comprehension and detail rather than transcription of texts, allowing all types of material. There is no minimum score required on the exam for the PECs to be included in the final grade.
